performance.distilled_role_note: Also passes literal state-or-point reduction gate versus unpruned original J102. J_USED is selected as DISTILLED because it has smaller private state, lower point latency, one ensemble and exact original quality.

candidate.hypothesis: The forecast channel is serially correlated even under a stationary null. An independent-observation sum variance can overstate long-age GLR and mean-prior Bayes evidence.
candidate.change: Only replace age n by the H-fitted AR(1) variance of each channel sum in GLR and analytic mean-prior Bayes summaries; derived memory follows corrected GLR. Keep instantaneous, EWMA, CUSUM, H AR/ARCH fitting and old 51 features unchanged.
candidate.expected_effect: Improve comparability across H persistence regimes and reduce spurious long-age evidence.
candidate.risks: AR(1) is an approximation to nonlinear, clipped energy channels. Estimated H autocorrelation is noisy, and removing persistence can weaken a genuine variance shift. This is not a valid e-process or guaranteed false-alarm likelihood.

candidate.hypothesis: The variance-pair family gains from sequential integration. Test whether extending the fixed logarithmic age grid captures slower changes beyond 128 points.
candidate.change: Only max_age changes from 128 to 512; add the preimplemented 256/512 ages. Same channels, H fit, learner and weighting.
candidate.expected_effect: Stronger accumulated weak scale evidence at long break ages.
candidate.risks: Long windows mix pre/post observations near a recent break, increase state memory and can delay a response. The original screen still decides full-CV admission.

candidate.hypothesis: The +.00233 long-age gain over the 128-age parent needs matched attribution to GLR memory, Bayes tau integration and the forecast channel, plus a bounded speed tradeoff.
candidate.change: Remove explicit GLR and GLR memory features; retain local and Bayes evidence.
candidate.expected_effect: Separate useful slow-change evidence from persistent maxima and evaluate fixed smaller forests without altering online statistics.
candidate.risks: Adaptively nominated from DEV; nested full evaluations are conditional. The same fixed screen can reject an ablation even if its unobserved full score would be useful. No failed-screen override is allowed.
